_about: Public-domain Samuel Stennett (1727-1795), Particular Baptist minister of Little Wild Street, London, and hymn writer, for the Word Hoard: Discourses on Personal Religion (2 vols., 1769), Discourses on Domestic Duties (1783), Discourses on the Parable of the Sower, his two books against infant baptism by sprinkling (1772, 1775), and his single sermons. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 88 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
